description: This PHP source file handles the process of updating relationships between products and other entities within the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves request parameters, processes entity IDs, and invokes functions to relate entities, followed by redirecting to a different view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class providing an interface for CRM entities, including method getInstance initialized with the current module.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data from request parameters to prevent security issues.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab context for the current request.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Static method that returns an instance of CRMEntity associated with the current module.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Links the specified entities together within the CRM system based on provided parameters.
